Why: the last two findings reported `Unexpected '}'` at column 132 then 120 — exactly one past the end of the mutation I sent both times (lengths 131 and 119, both balanced and verified in-file). That pattern means the pre-check transport appends one trailing `}` to the query before sending it to the replica, so a fully-balanced stored mutation arrives with one brace too many. With the final brace omitted in the file, the transmitted query is the complete balanced mutation. If the next finding shows a different error location, that will falsify this hypothesis and I'll redesign the write instead.
